inputSpecification:
RGBI-channels from orthophoto with 25 cm resolution and LiDAR nDSM at 1 m resolution resampled to 25cm
zarr format
outputSpecification: The model generates a two-channel logit map per pixel (representing background and building classes) in TIFF format, which is transformed into a geopackage
trainingDataOrigin: Remote sensing data from different parts of Catalonia collected by the ICGC.
